facts.text: Serve the snacks when the crew stumble out of two years in stasis and Vickers drops for push-ups.
facts.why: The plot summary and the quote pages I opened do not place Vickers's push-ups. In the film she does them in her own module, so they may not happen at the same moment the crew wake. Treat the timing as unconfirmed.
facts.fix: Serve the snacks when the crew wake from two years in stasis aboard the Prometheus.

facts.why: The note says Vickers eats this alone in her private module. No source I opened shows her eating anything, so the claim is made up. She does have a private module, but the food is invented.
facts.fix: Vickers keeps to her private module, and her own table.
facts.full: Vickers's pick, eaten alone in her private module.

facts.why: Janek's Christmas tree is in the film, but none of the pages I opened date the landing as Christmas Day. The ship's arrival date is not settled by my sources.
Same problem as the Wellington. The year 2093 is right for the ship, but a Christmas Day arrival is not confirmed by the sources I opened.

vibe.verdict: A smart airline galley that nails the Christmas tree and Lawrence of Arabia gags, but it stays polite for a film about a very bad dinner party.
missing: The Engineer drinking the black liquid at the waterfall (opening scene)
David's line 'Big things have small beginnings' (the lab)
Shaw cutting out the squid baby on the surgery table
Fifield's helmet melting after the snake attack
David's glowing holographic star map room
ideas: Swap 'Hummus with warm flatbread' for 'Squid in a pastry blanket' as a nod to Shaw's surgery table scene.
Swap the plain 'Weyland Corporation Expedition' venue line for the Weyland TED talk quote about the future, as a menu header.
Add a dish called 'Fifield's melted helmet jelly' to the sweets to give the food some horror bite.
Swap 'Peated single malt, neat' for 'Janek's squeezebox tune' as a drink name, to use the accordion on the bridge.
